card.name: Chapter marker in textbook citations
card.fires_on: The word "chap" (chapter) right after the year and colon in a textbook citation, such as "Philadelphia, PA: Elsevier Saunders; 2011:". It also fires weakly on section-heading words in patient-information pages.

modes.label: Citation chapter
modes.description: The start of "chapter" after the publisher and year in a reference to a medical textbook.
modes.example: Textbook of Endocrinology . 12th ed. Philadelphia, PA: Elsevier Saunders; 2011:<<chap>> 34. Jensen RT,

modes.label: Patient-page headings
modes.description: Heading or list words in health-information pages, such as provider, Names, or incidence.
modes.example: Call your health care<< provider>> if you develop any symptoms of insulinoma
